race_context: The 'Spencer Owen County School Board' seats belong to Spencer-Owen Community School Corporation (Spencer-Owen Community Schools), based in Spencer in Owen County {socs_home}{nces_socs}. It runs four elementary schools (Gosport, McCormick's Creek, Patricksburg and Spencer, each pre-K to grade 6), Owen Valley Middle School and Owen Valley High School {socs_home}. The district reports 2,172 enrolled students; federal data list 2,156 students in six schools in 2024-25 {socs_home}{nces_socs}. Miles A. Cline is superintendent {socs_sup_contract}{socs_min_20260108}.

The Board of School Trustees has seven members {socs_home}{socs_min_20260611}. The state candidate list shows the 2026 seats as residence districts (District 2, District 3 and 'District 5(1)'), each 'vote for 1' {in_list}. The district's website does not explain the district plan or say which seat each member holds, so the number of members per district and the meaning of the '(1)' label could not be confirmed from a fetched source {socs_home}.

Current members (2026 officers): Derek Morgan (president, on the board since 2021), Deana Stickels (vice president, since January 2025), Elizabeth 'Lizz' Bixler (secretary, since 2023), Rick Smeltzer (secretary pro tem, since 2005), Chad Cooper (since 2017), Mark Rogers (since 2021) and Jack White (since 2010) {socs_home}{socs_min_20260108}.

Who is running again: Bixler is the only current member on the 2026 ballot list, in District 3 {socs_home}{in_list}. Rogers and White are not on the 2026 ballot list {in_list}. Which current members hold the District 2 and District 5(1) seats could not be confirmed; if they are Rogers's and White's seats, both races will produce new members, but this guide did not verify that {socs_home}{in_list}.
Party labels: the state list shows Jama Brown with the Republican label and the other four candidates as nonpartisan {in_list}.

Budget and the 2025 property-tax law: on February 26, 2026 the board held a work session at which Jason O'Neill of Policy Analytics presented on the impact of SEA 1 on property tax collections and funding for the district; the minutes attach but do not summarize the presentation {socs_ws_20260226}. On September 10, 2026 the board voted 5-0 to renew Policy Analytics' property tax base and revenue analysis at $11,000, up $1,000 {socs_min_20260910}.

2027 budget: the superintendent presented the 2027 budget at an August 13, 2026 workshop, no one spoke at the September 10 public budget hearing, and on September 24, 2026 the board voted 6-0 to adopt the 2027 budget, tax rate, capital projects fund plan and bus replacement plan {socs_min_20260813}{socs_min_20260910}{socs_min_20260924}. No operating or safety referendum appears in the 2026 minutes reviewed for this guide {socs_min_20260924}.

Facilities: the board has used 2024 bond money for projects including $112,100 in first-floor flooring at Owen Valley Middle School (approved 7-0 on June 11, 2026) and a Gosport Elementary HVAC demolition project estimated at $131,225 (approved 5-0 on July 16, 2026), when it also authorized seeking proposals for a Gosport Elementary roof repair of $150,000 {socs_min_20260611}{socs_min_20260716}. In May 2025 the board approved a reconstruction contract for flood damage at Owen Valley High School {socs_min_20250508}. A March 31, 2026 public work session discussed future planning and potential projects {socs_ws_20260331}.

Superintendent contract: the board held a public hearing on June 11, 2026 on a proposed contract for Superintendent Cline running July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2028 at a $135,000 base salary, with a $2,500 stipend if the corporation receives an 'A' state letter grade and $1,000 for a 'B'; no one commented {socs_sup_contract}{socs_min_20260611}.

Programs and staffing: on February 12, 2026 the board voted 7-0 to approve the first phase of a cosmetology pathway at Owen Valley High School, and in March it reassigned a teaching position to a cosmetology instructor {socs_min_20260212}{socs_min_20260312}. A teacher compensation and collective bargaining hearing was held September 10, 2026 {socs_hearing_20260910}.
Board votes: nearly all 2026 votes in the minutes reviewed were unanimous; on January 22, 2026 Jack White abstained on one personnel item, which passed 5-0-1 {socs_min_20260122}.
Forums: no candidate forum or questionnaire for these races was found for this guide.
